evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies peer message processing and orphan transaction handling in ProcessMessages.
rationale: Eliminating unconditional `cs_main` acquisition in `ProcessOrphanTx` prevents the P2P message handler from blocking on validation, RPC, or wallet locks when peers have no pending orphan work. The author demonstrates that under `cs_main` contention, ping handling latency in `ProcessMessages` drops from 50.1 ms to 0.02 ms.
